Each module aborts on nonzero exit or unstable source; child failure propagates through check=True. All 114 receipts report stable successful compilation. Actual imports use the single-module syntax handled by the closure parser. The final audit validates expected roots and allowed axioms. These checks support removal of retained A1K objects, while leaving Lean/mathlib/package cache authenticity and independent reproduction outside scope.
